purpose: Test the next-4h OPEN timing assumption in MR40 historical replay; a genuine official Bybit Spot fourhour confirm true was independently received 816.2316ms after the 4h boundary, so exact boundary OPEN was already past when the signal could have been acted on.

historical_sample.boundaries: all 6 chronological UTC 4h starts per day, including the first 00:00 UTC; N=12; no selecting profitable or entry-specific boundaries
historical_sample.basis: Already known and previously evaluated days, not untouched future data. The latency-specific metric thresholds are fixed before evaluating this metric but NOT a truly blind test.

cost_free_tick_proxy.reference: FIRST trade print at or after exact 4h boundary (historical 4h OPEN as first print)
cost_free_tick_proxy.delayed_proxy: FIRST actual Bybit Spot trade print at or after boundary+latency_ms. Not a guaranteed achievable market order fill, nor quote or midpoint.
cost_free_tick_proxy.price_delta_bps: (delayed_trade_price - reference_first_trade_price)/reference_first_trade_price * 10000; positive means higher price (adverse to hypothetical buy), negative adverse to sell
cost_free_tick_proxy.coverage: Fail if any of the 12 selected fixed 4h starts lacks either a baseline or a delayed trade in the same 4h bin. Report lag-to-first-trade after threshold, absolute and signed bp differences, max, mean absolute, zero/nonzero counts; do not optimize threshold or trade direction.
cost_free_tick_proxy.nonfill: Cannot derive executable price, spread, fees, order book, available liquidity, size slippage or actual broker fills from last-sale trade prints.
